records.description: Foundation states that its first-generation Passport hardware wallet, later described as the Passport Founder’s Edition, was introduced in mid-2020.
records.title: First-generation Passport introduced

records.description: Foundation renamed its existing second-generation Passport, previously referred to as Passport Batch 2, to Passport Core while keeping it in the product line alongside Passport Prime.
records.notes: This is modeled as a product rebrand, not a new hardware generation.
records.title: Second-generation Passport renamed Passport Core

records.description: Foundation later stated that it launched its second-generation Passport device in March 2022. This second-generation product was originally known as Passport Batch 2 and was renamed Passport Core in 2025.
records.notes: WLR records month precision only. The contemporaneous March 10, 2022 Batch 2 announcement was still at the presale stage, so that announcement date is not treated as an exact shipment or general-availability day.
records.title: Second-generation Passport launched as Passport Batch 2

records.description: Foundation released Envoy during 2022 as a mobile Passport companion and Bitcoin software-wallet application for iOS and Android.
records.notes: Year precision only. Foundation stated on 2022-03-10 that Envoy would launch later, while the official Envoy repository published v1.0.7 Android/iOS release artifacts in October 2022 and Foundation subsequently described v1.0.7 as live on mobile platforms.
records.title: Foundation Envoy released on mobile platforms

records.description: Foundation first-party shipping history establishes that Passport Prime entered its shipping/release lineage during 2025 after the 2024 announcement and preorder period.
records.notes: Year precision only. Foundation still described future Early Access shipping in May 2025 and later stated that Passport Prime was beginning to ship in October 2025; no exact first shipment day is asserted.
records.title: Passport Prime began shipping in 2025

records.notes: Primary legal source for Foundation Devices, Inc., its U.S. location, and Envoy's role as a mobile companion application.
records.title: Foundation Terms of Use

records.notes: Primary history source for the 2020 first generation, Founder’s Edition, Batch 2/Core continuity, 2025 rename, Prime, and Envoy product family.
records.title: Passport is now Passport Core

records.notes: Current documentation identifies Passport Core and states that instructions also apply to Founder’s Edition devices on version 2.1.0 and above.
records.title: Passport Core Home

records.notes: Current first-party product comparison for Passport Core and Passport Prime.
records.title: Compare Products

records.notes: Describes Prime as an offline Bitcoin key-management device and Envoy as its companion app, while noting Envoy can hold keys for its own built-in hot wallet.
records.title: Passport Prime Terms of Use

records.notes: First-party Foundation retrospective explicitly stating that in March 2022 Foundation launched its second-generation Passport device.
records.title: Announcing Our $7M Seed Round

records.notes: First-party pre-launch boundary: Foundation announces Envoy and explicitly says it will launch in app stores later alongside Passport Batch 2. This source is not treated as the release date itself.
records.title: Introducing Passport Batch 2 & Envoy Mobile App

records.notes: Official Envoy repository release containing Android App Bundle/APK and iOS IPA artifacts in October 2022. Used with the March pre-launch announcement to establish only that the initial public product launch occurred in 2022.
records.title: Envoy Release 1.0.7

records.notes: First-party Foundation article stating that Passport Prime begins shipping. Used to establish the 2025 release/shipping year, not an exact first shipment day.
records.title: Passport Prime Security Audit

records.notes: First-party Foundation customer shipping update stating that remaining components were still arriving and the 1,000 Early Access orders were expected to be assembled and shipped afterward. Used to avoid backdating the release to the 2024 announcement/preorder period.
records.title: Shipping Updates for Passport Prime and Core
